name: neobrutalism-tabs
title: Tabs
description: Brutalist tab components for Tailwind CSS. Bold, minimalist tabbed navigation with stark borders, high contrast, and raw typography. Stripped-down tabs UI for no-nonsense content organization.
useWhen: Switching between a small number of peer content panels with a bold visual navigation style.
Keeping related sections in the same page context without a full navigation change.
avoidWhen: There are more than six labels or labels do not fit on mobile.
The user must complete panels in a required sequence.
responsiveBehavior: Horizontal tab rows scroll or wrap intentionally on small screens; vertical tabs become stacked when there is insufficient inline space.
accessibility: Implement the tablist, tab, and tabpanel roles with aria-selected and aria-controls.
Arrow keys move focus between tabs; active focus remains highly visible.
